planSprint.label: Davrni rejalashtirish

deadlineRisk.label: Muddat xavfi

weeklySummary.label: Haftalik xulosa

draftEvent.label: Tadbir loyihasi

summarizeThread.label: Muhokamani xulosalash

nlAnalytics.label: Tahlildan soʻrash
nlAnalytics.description: Oddiy tildagi savolni filtr va diagramma turiga aylantiradi.

whatDidIMiss.label: Nimani oʻtkazib yubordim
